description: This file defines the interface for EC Host Commands in the Zephyr project, including enums for response codes and debug levels, structures for command headers and handler arguments, macros for registering command handlers, and function prototypes for initializing and managing host commands.
published: int ec_host_cmd_send_response(enum ec_host_cmd_status status, const struct ec_host_cmd_handler_args *args)

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_init
methods.description: Initializes the host command subsystem with a specified backend.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_send_response
methods.description: Sends a response for a host command, including status and handler arguments.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_rx_notify
methods.description: Signals that a new host command has been received.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_set_user_cb
methods.description: Sets a user callback to be invoked after receiving a host command.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_get_hc
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the main host command structure.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_send_in_progress_ended
methods.description: Checks if a host command that was in progress has ended.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_send_in_progress_status
methods.description: Retrieves the final status of a host command that was in progress.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_send_in_progress_continue
methods.description: Continues processing a command that returned EC_HOST_CMD_IN_PROGRESS.

methods.name: ec_host_cmd_add_suppressed
methods.description: Adds a command ID to the list of suppressed commands (not logged).
